notesDetails.title: Effort Scaling on Gemini 4 Carbon: Medium Cut LLM Turns by 51% (97 vs. 198), Tokens by 59% (11.12M vs. 26.88M) & Cost by 53% ($3.35 vs. $7.16)
bullets: Lowest Turn Count, Token Volume & Billed Cost Among All Gemini 4 Runs: Compared directly against `gemini-4-carbon` (`High`) on the exact same `antigravity cli` harness and `$2.00/$0.10/$10.00` rate schedule, `Medium` effort cleared all `7/7` slices while cutting LLM calls by `51.0%` (`97` vs. `198` — fewest turns of any Gemini 4 run, below `argon` `131`, `hydrogen` `144`, and `neon` `151`), total tokens by `58.6%` (`11.12M` vs. `26.88M`), active runtime by `39.8%` (`53m` vs. `88m` active / `108m` wall-clock), and billed cost by `53.2%` (`$3.35` vs. `$7.16` — also edging `argon`'s `$3.37` and `hydrogen`'s `$3.42` as the cheapest Gemini 4 `7/7` run).

Higher Per-Turn Action Density Instead of Shallow Reasoning (`643` vs. `403` Thinking Tokens/Turn): Despite running at `Medium` effort, the model averaged `643` thinking tokens per turn (`62,413` total across `97` turns vs. `79,702` across `198` turns on `High`, `-21.7%` total thinking) because it consolidated planning into fewer, denser turns—issuing `2.01` tool calls per LLM turn (`195` tools / `97` turns; `63` of `97` turns / `64.9%` batched `2–5` parallel tool calls) compared to `1.17` tools/turn (`27` multi-tool turns) on `High`.

Inference vs. Tool Wall-Clock Split: Model generation across the `97` turns accounted for `2,518.6s` (`41m 58.6s`, `79.6%` of run duration, averaging `25.97s/turn`), while all `195` tool executions and `8` backgrounded `run_command` tasks completed in `645.5s` (`10m 45.5s`, `20.4%`).
